text:
Priya Nair: Heads-up 1 candidate: Karan Patel (Bengaluru). He's progressed to final onsite loop but has questions about visa sponsorship timeline and background check timing before offers. Interview window options: Tue 09:0012:00 IST or Wed 14:0017:00 IST. Needs bank-account setup guidance too (for INR vs USD payroll).
Arjun Singh: I can cover system design Tue 09:3010:30 IST. Tue works better for me.
Leah Collins: I can do coding Tue 10:4512:00 IST. Prefer CoderPad.
Victor Chen: Hiring manager wrap I can do Tue 12:0012:30 IST. If candidate needs visa sponsor docs earlier we should align with Legal.
Maya Ortiz: People-ops note: payroll for India hires requires local onboarding packet and W-8BEN is NOT applicable. We typically pay INR via local partner. Need candidate bank details after offer. Also we can offer a short "hire-to-visa" checklist if LegalOps signs off.
Priya Nair: Candidate question: "If offered, how long until visa sponsorship paperwork starts?" Also he asked whether background check can start pre-offer to speed up start date.
LegalOps: Quick reply: Redwood typically issues offer letter first. We do not commence sponsorship paperwork before signed offer. Background checks may begin after offer acceptance in most cases, unless hiring lead requests pre-offer check for critical roles; that requires a legal exception and candidate written consent. We can provide an estimated timeline: 2-6 weeks for sponsorship initiation + govt processing (varies by country).
bg-check-bot: Vendor note: Standard background checks in India (education + employment) average 4-7 business days once we have candidate consent and documents. Criminal checks vary by region.
Priya Nair: Candidate is keen to fast-track. Any way to compress timeline? We could: 1) prepare offer draft ASAP, 2) get candidate to sign LOA/consent to BG on conditional offer, 3) Legal starts sponsor packet after signed acceptance. Is that allowed?
LegalOps: We can do conditional offer + candidate-signed BG consent. Sponsorship paperwork still requires signed offer and signed employment contract to proceed. We can pre-draft the sponsor packet so it's ready the day the contract is signed.
Arjun Singh: For scheduling, Tue works. Can we add 15-min buffer between design and coding? Candidate said he needs to step away for childcare at 11:30.
Leah Collins: 15-min buffer fine. Proposed schedule: design 09:3010:30, break 10:3010:45, coding 10:4512:00, HM 12:0012:30.
Priya Nair: I'll confirm with candidate and ask if he wants the offer pre-draft to review early (non-binding). Also will ask for BG consent form and scanned degree certs to speed checks.
Maya Ortiz: Also note: if candidate later needs relocation, we have an INR payroll + relocation stipend policy for India hires. I'll attach link in candidate message: https://people.redwood.ai/onboarding/intl-payroll.
Victor Chen: Regarding work-authority, if he needs a PIO/OCI or other permit, LegalOps should confirm specifics.
LegalOps: We will check typical processing for Indian nationals for US work visas (H-1B/other) vs local employment. But question: is this role remote in India or relocation to US? Please confirm.
Priya Nair: Role is Bangalore-based (local hire) but candidate asked about future internal mobility to US sites. We should be transparent: sponsor for intra-company transfers considered later, not guaranteed at offer stage.
Recruiter-bot: Draft calendar event created: https://calendar.redwood.ai/events/1880007777  invites pending until candidate confirms Tue window. Includes CoderPad link placeholder, payroll note, and "pre-offer info pack" option.
Priya Nair: Candidate replied: prefers Tue and would like pre-draft offer to review, and is happy to sign BG consent immediately. He also asked whether we can accept scanned degree + digital verification link (he has a certified digital transcript).
bg-check-bot: We accept scanned degree with certified digital verification links (please provide URL + notarization if applicable). Sending consent form: https://vendor.bg/check-consent?id=1880007777
LegalOps: We'll prepare conditional offer draft and LOA for any equipment loan (if requested). Note: BG consent link must go through vendor; Priya please confirm candidate identity details (full name as on degree, DOB) before sending.
Priya Nair: Sent consent form and requested scanned degree and DOB. Also included pre-draft offer doc (non-binding) with compensation bands and local benefits summary.
Leah Collins: All set for Tue. I'll prep CoderPad and bilingual instructions (EN + Kannada) in case candidate prefers local language for small clarifications.
Maya Ortiz: I'll attach payroll FAQ and a checklist: "What to expect after sign" with expected timelines (BG 4-7 days, sponsor packet ready within 2 business days of signed contract).
Victor Chen: If BG flags any issue we should loop LegalOps immediately. Also prefer BG to be in parallel to relocation discussions to minimize delay.
Priya Nair: Candidate accepted Tue slot and signed BG consent. He also uploaded digital transcript link. Sending confirmation message now (excerpt): "Thanks Karan  Tue confirmed. We've received your consent and transcript; Legal will draft conditional offer and BG will begin once we have acceptance. We'll share sponsor packet timeline if necessary."
recruiter-bot: Reminder scheduled: send candidate BG checklist and pre-offer FAQ 24h before interview.
Priya Nair: Closing note: team, thanks for quick turnaround. I'll update channel if Legal needs anything else.
